$comment: Narrow upstream rejection signatures. Only signatures quoted verbatim by official documentation or reproduced from a recorded sample are listed; anything else is shown to the user as the raw error and never inferred. Matching: status equals httpStatus; errorCode, when present, equals error.type or error.code; messagePattern is a case-insensitive regex (no lookbehind, portable to Swift/Kotlin/JS/Rust) tested against error.message. byWireFamily entries apply only when the request carried a part of that wire family; byProtocol entries apply to any request of that protocol. First match wins in file order. candidates are not signatures: they need a recorded sample before they move into a group.

notFound: openai_responses input_image / input_file: no official rejection text (checked 2026-10-19)
anthropic image / document blocks on a model without vision: no official rejection text (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors, 2026-10-19)
gemini inline_data / file_data: only a generic 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT is documented (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/api-errors, 2026-10-19); status + code alone would misfire

openai_chat / openai_responses temperature / top_p on reasoning models: no official rejection text; error-codes page lists only service_tier for 400 (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes, /guides/reasoning, 2026-10-21); body shape of openai.unsupported_parameter is corroborated only by a third-party fixture (vercel/ai packages/openai/src/chat/__fixtures__/reasoning-model-legacy-parameter-error.json), so it stays a candidate
openai_chat response_format json_schema on an unsupported model: no official rejection text (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/structured-outputs, 2026-10-21)

openai_chat file / video_url content parts on an unsupported model: no official rejection text; docs only say Chat Completions accepts PDF as file parts (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/pdf-files, 2026-10-21)

anthropic temperature / top_p / top_k on models after Opus 4.6: docs state a 400 but give no message text (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages/create, 2026-10-21); status + type alone would misfire
gemini temperature / top_p / top_k on Gemini 4 and 3.6+: currently ignored, 400 only announced for a future release (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/troubleshooting, 2026-10-21)
deepseek image / file / sampling parameters: only generic 400 / 422 descriptions (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/error_codes, 2026-10-21)

qwen (DashScope) parameter range and file format errors are documented but mean a bad value or format, not a missing capability; not mapped to param_rejected / input_rejected (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/error-code, 2026-10-21)
